items.title: Dave Pell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 11, 1996
items.q: I mean Les Brown, I had a great time with Lester’s band and played on every tune

ctx.x: Sounds like you didn’t lack for self confidence.

Oh, no, I was a smart ass, it was terrible. I was just terrible. But that’s kind of a thing that you have to do. It’s almost like the sidemen on the band, they keep watching the leader. And watching all the mistakes he makes. And all the wrong things he does. Because in the back of his mind, I’m going to be a leader some day and I ain’t never gonna put myself — I mean Les Brown, I had a great time with Lester’s band and played on every tune, you know I had a great, great book to play, and we had [Don] Fagerquist…
Well when you became a leader I assume you kept your horn out of the way anyway.
